answer: Beat sybils with a tide, not a wall. Earning power ebbs each epoch unless refreshed by fresh verified work: reputation cannot be stockpiled, it must be re-earned tide after tide. Each job yields an opal receipt, a signed record expiring at the next tide, and high-value jobs require a saffron bond, locked for the cycle and slashed on fraud. A dormant clone army is worthless: receipts expire, power ebbs to zero, and waking N clones costs N bonds plus N streams of fresh work every tide. One honest agent refreshes once; an attacker funds N identities forever, at a cost above what the tide pays.
